    if len(others) < 1:
        return [[bg] * len(grid[0]) for _ in range(len(grid))]
    
    others.sort(key=lambda x: len(x[1]), reverse=True)
    
    pattern_cells = others[0][1]
    
    if not pattern_cells:
        return [[bg] * len(grid[0]) for _ in range(len(grid))]
    
    # If only one non-bg color, just return bg-only grid
    if len(others) == 1:
        return [[bg] * len(grid[0]) for _ in range(len(grid))]
    
    pattern_color, pattern_cells = others[0]
    signal_cells = others[1]
    
    if not pattern_cells or not signal_cells:
        return [[bg] * len(grid[0]) for _ in range(len(grid))]
    
    # Get pattern bounding box
    min_r, max_r = min(p[0] for p in pattern_cells), max(p[0] for p in pattern_cells)
    min_c, max_c = min(p[1] for p in pattern_cells), max(p[1] for p in pattern_cells)
    
    H, W = max_r - min_r + 1, max_c - min_c + 1
    
    # Pattern from signal position - map signal as the shape to determine copy
    # Use signal extent as copy location finder
    sig_min_r, sig_max_r = min(p[0] for p in signal_cells), max(p[0] for p in signal_cells)
    sig_min_c, sig_max_c = min(p[1] for p in signal_cells), max(p[1] for p in signal_cells)
    
    # Output grid
    out = [[bg] * len(grid[0]) for _ in range(len(grid))]
    
    # Copy pattern at original position
    for r, c in pattern_cells:
        out[r][c] = pattern_color
    
    # Use signal as copy location offset
    for r, c in pattern_cells:
        new_r = sig_min_r + (r - min_r)
        new_c = sig_min_c + (c - min_c)
        if 0 <= new_r < len(out) and 0 <= new_c < len(out[0]):
            out[new_r][new_c] = pattern_color
    
    return out
